text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was in a meeting with Fusaichi 
Pandora...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list: You look sleepy, what's the matter?
You look sleepy, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, I was texting my friends on LANE, 
and before I knew it, it was the middle of 
the night~~...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Did you say we have training 
after this? No waaaay, I can't do iiiit...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we just take a nap for today? 
There's no point doing it all 
sleepy-weepy... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Fusaichi Pandora wasn't able to 
rest well...
